open_points.subject: A3 Required tests for INV-009
open_points.text: after several revoke-and-grant cycles of one pair, every earlier record is still stored as revoked and exactly one is active
open_points.question: How many completed revoke-and-grant cycles must the INV-009 required test perform to satisfy “several”?
options: Two completed revoke-and-grant cycles are sufficient.
At least three completed revoke-and-grant cycles are required.
A specific larger number of cycles must be stated.
open_points.default_guess: Require three completed revoke-and-grant cycles before checking that every earlier record remains revoked and exactly one record is active.

witness.initial: One viewer/project, staff/project, or service-principal/project pair has no grant or assignment records.
events: An administrator grants or assigns the pair, revokes the active record, and grants or assigns it again.
The administrator repeats the revoke-and-grant sequence.
A focused INV-009 test evaluates the resulting history.
outcomes: One implementer treats two completed revoke-and-grant cycles as “several” and considers the required test complete.
Another implementer requires at least three completed revoke-and-grant cycles and rejects the same test as incomplete.
witness.observer: The Factory verification reviewer sees different test acceptance for the same required invariant.
